objective: Add QuickActionBar and DosingSummaryCard UI components to Dashboard, update osaka_pump design token to sky and SensorBentoCard border radius to rounded-[18px], and enforce frontend quality checks in CI.

acceptance.criterion: QuickActionBar renders action buttons for Châm dinh dưỡng, Tạm dừng/Tiếp tục bơm, and Xem cảnh báo, invoking appropriate callbacks when clicked.
DosingSummaryCard renders total dosing count and last dosed time formatted, or fallback text when lastDosedAt is null.
Dashboard component wires QuickActionBar and DosingSummaryCard, eliminates prohibited indigo token for osaka_pump, and SensorBentoCard uses rounded-[18px].
Frontend code passes TypeScript compilation, ESLint with zero warnings, Vitest tests, and Vite production build.
acceptance.verification: cd hydragrow-frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint . && npm run test && npm run build
